contract: A requester without cluster Create authorization stores no token.
The owner and a listed renewer can renew until the maximum timestamp. Another principal cannot renew or expire the token.
Authentication fails for a wrong secret, an expired token, and a revoked token.
Debug and describe output omit the secret. Reopen accepts the issued secret and still rejects the revoked token id.
limits: This is not the CreateDelegationToken, RenewDelegationToken, or ExpireDelegationToken RPC.
The token is not wired into SASL authentication.
The journal format is the local PLTKN001 record.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
